scientific_integrity: All exact identities were reconstructed with a standalone symbolic checker and the universal four-tip and cubic-sign arguments were independently assessed. Prior model, GLS formula, and tree-based sampling motivation are expressly attributed; no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Known rooted fully binary strictly positive-edge ultrametric phylogeny and Brownian traits at fixed evolutionary variance rate.
Known equal independent Gaussian measurement-error variance and one observation from each selected tip; solely the root trait mean is estimated.
Sharp minimum-taxon statement, not a classification of every five-tip tree or an optimization theorem for large arbitrary phylogenies.
Specialized correlated-Gaussian optimal-design literature may contain an equivalent statement not surfaced in the searches.
title: Five tips are the sharp threshold for noise-driven changes in optimal phylogenetic sampling
